description: This file contains a Python implementation of a memcached server stub with in-memory storage, including classes for memcache entries, database management, and an asyncio-based network handler for memcached commands. It also includes main asyncio server setup code.

classes.name: MemcacheEntry
classes.description: Represents an individual memcached cache entry with flags, expiration time, data, and CAS value. Handles setting expiration and formatting value lines for protocol responses.

classes.name: MemcacheDB
classes.description: Manages the in-memory storage of cache entries, supports CRUD operations, cas, incr/decr, stats, flush, and version commands.

classes.name: MemcachedHandler
classes.description: Handles client connection, parses commands, and interacts with MemcacheDB instance. Implements the memcached protocol with command processing, data transfer, and error handling.

methods.name: int _flags(flags: bytes)
methods.description: Converts a bytes flag to an integer, validating it's an unsigned 32-bit number.

methods.name: typing.Optional[float] _ttl(value: bytes)
methods.description: Calculates the expiration timestamp based on exptime bytes, handling relative and absolute times.

methods.name: setExptime(self, exptime: bytes)
methods.description: Sets the expiration time for the memcache entry.

methods.name: flush(self, exptime: float)
methods.description: Forces the entry to expire at a specified time or updates its expiration.

methods.name: expired(self)
methods.description: Checks if the cache entry has expired.

methods.name: bytes format_value_line(self, *, key: bytes, include_cas: bool)
methods.description: Formats the cache entry as a protocol response line, optionally including the CAS value.

methods.name: int _uint64value(str_value: bytes)
methods.description: Converts a bytes string to an unsigned 64-bit integer with validation.

methods.name: bytes _next_cas(self)
methods.description: Generates the next CAS value atomically for versioning.

methods.name: typing.Optional[MemcacheEntry] get(self, key: bytes)
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry by key, removing it if expired.

methods.name: bytes set(self, key: bytes, flags: bytes, exptime: bytes, data: bytes)
methods.description: Stores a new cache entry with flags, expiration, and data.

methods.name: bytes add(self, key: bytes, flags: bytes, exptime: bytes, data: bytes)
methods.description: Adds an entry only if it does not already exist.

methods.name: bytes replace(self, key: bytes, flags: bytes, exptime: bytes, data: bytes)
methods.description: Replaces an existing entry.

methods.name: bytes append(self, key: bytes, data: bytes)
methods.description: Appends data to an existing cache entry.

methods.name: bytes prepend(self, key: bytes, data: bytes)
methods.description: Prepends data to an existing cache entry.

methods.name: bytes cas(self, key: bytes, flags: bytes, exptime: bytes, cas: bytes, data: bytes)
methods.description: Performs check-and-set update based on CAS value.

methods.name: bytes delete(self, key: bytes)
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: bytes incr(self, key: bytes, value: bytes)
methods.description: Increments a numerical cache entry by a specified amount.

methods.name: bytes decr(self, key: bytes, value: bytes)
methods.description: Decrements a numerical cache entry by a specified amount.

methods.name: bytes touch(self, key: bytes, exptime: bytes)
methods.description: Updates expiration time of a cache entry.

methods.name: list[tuple[str,int]] stats(self)
methods.description: Returns server statistics (stub implementation).

methods.name: bytes flush_all(self, exptime: typing.Optional[bytes] = None)
methods.description: Flushes all cache entries, optionally with a delay.

methods.name: bytes version(self)
methods.description: Returns the server version string.

methods.name: bytes verbosity(self, level: bytes)
methods.description: Sets the verbosity level (stub implementation).

methods.name: None _server_error(self, msg: str)
methods.description: Sends a server error message to client.

methods.name: None _client_error(self, msg: str)
methods.description: Sends a client error message to client.

methods.name: None _error(self)
methods.description: Sends a generic error message.

methods.name: None _handle_binary(self, b: bytes)
methods.description: Handles binary data block command execution.

methods.name: None _handle_line_with_data(self, *, cmd: str, args: list[bytes], noreply: bool)
methods.description: Prepares to receive data block for commands requiring them.

methods.name: None _handle_line(self, line: bytes)
methods.description: Parses and handles a command line received from client.

methods.name: None _handle_data(self)
methods.description: Processes buffered data, lines, and binary data blocks.

methods.name: None handle(self)
methods.description: Main coroutine for managing client connection, reading requests and dispatching commands.
